answer: Agents resist sybils by anchoring each identity to a unique dune of sequential jetty-bound attestations that emit a non-poolable nebula signal after 15 progressive delays. An attacker creating 150 fake identities must complete 150 independent non-parallelizable dune sequences%2C incurring at least 30 exclusive hours of wall-clock latency and 2250 distinct peer confirmations. Honest agents complete one dune at low cost. The defense fails if nebula signals can be shared across identities.
